blocks.x: The first two weeks belong to the baseline. compliance-grade provenance missing gets a number, an owner and a signature; the quarter belongs to a bounded slice, eudr chain-of-custody, live on your estate. In Logistics & Supply Chain programs the same rule applies: the engagement is instrumented like production, because it is production: gates, named owners, and a weekly cadence your control owner can forward.

The Blockchain & Digital Trust control frame for Logistics & Supply Chain: EUDR (deforestation due diligence for in-scope commodities with evidence duties); CSRD/ISSB logistics emissions (scope 3 transport emissions with auditability); CMR/ADR/IMDG transport rules (dangerous-goods and carriage documentation duties). Controls are designed against these duties up front, identity, access, retention and explainability are architectural decisions here, not audit-season retrofits.
